key_findings: Ridge has complete historical ADV coverage and similar capacity to existing contenders, so weak H20-H120 portfolio evidence is not explained by missing liquidity.
At H20 ridge modestly beats the train-only dynamic composite after costs but remains far behind EW5 and 52W High.
At H60 ridge is the weakest long-only contender and remains materially negative after costs.
At H120 ridge improves on EW5 but remains well behind the train-only dynamic composite and 52W High after costs.
H252 ridge is strongest in the only available fold, but one independent fold is insufficient for any stability or promotion conclusion.
The first real ML challenger does not justify automatic escalation to more complex ML; any nonlinear challenger must be separately preregistered.
